PTA.full_name: proportional, integral, and derivative threshold adaptation

threshold_ranges.HM: one homogeneous interval shared by every agent and task
threshold_ranges.HT1: heterogeneous intervals with agent level specialization
threshold_ranges.HT2: heterogeneous intervals with agent and task variation

stored_threshold_modes.clamped: store the updated threshold inside its admissible range
stored_threshold_modes.latent: retain the unconstrained stored value and clamp only the effective selection threshold

gain_schemes.Global: all agents use the same P, I, and D gains
gain_schemes.Agent: agent gains are reproducible perturbations around tuned base gains
